FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR No. ITC/02/2022
Date: 09-01-2022
Subject: Time Slot Booking Module for Case Filing for convenience of
Ld. Advocates and their Clerks and Parties-In-Person
This is to inform all Ld. Advocates, Advocate Clerks and
Parties-In-Person intending to file cases in the High Court of Gujarat during
virtual working of the High Court, that, as per the guidance and directions
of Hon’ble the Chief Justice of High Court of Gujarat, an online module for
time slot booking for filing cases at Gate No. 5 of the High Court has been
developed and released in the Case Status website of the High Court of
Gujarat at http://gujarathc-casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/.
The objective of this module is to ensure safety and convenience for
the Ld. Advocates, Adv. Clerks and Parties-In-Person by avoiding any undue
rush/crowding during filing of cases in this pandemic crisis situation. This
module would also help them in saving their time by allowing them the
option to schedule their visit for filing. The Ld. Advocates/Parties-In-Person,
based on their registered mobile number, can log in to this module and
choose the desired available time slot from hourly slots for booking. After
the filing hours of the current working day are over, time slot can be booked
for any of the next working days till 31-01-2022. SMS confirmation will be
sent upon booking of the time slot.
On receipt of confirmation of appointment, the Ld. Advocate /
Party-In-Person will have to display their mobile phone at the filing counter
of such appointment having been obtained or produce the print-out, as
otherwise filing will not be accepted or received at the counter.
Time slot booking for physical filing would be available till 31st
January, 2022.
The User Guide explaining the process of using this ‘Time Slot
Booking’ module Case Filing is attached herewith.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
ONLINE METHOD TO BOOK SLOT FOR PHYSICAL FILING AT COURT COUNTER
� Visit Gujarat High Court website https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/ and click on => Case Status / Cause List / Orders / Judgement as below.
� Click on the icon SLOT BOOKING FOR FILING, as shown below.
ONLINE METHOD TO BOOK SLOT FOR PHYSICAL FILING AT COURT COUNTER
� Enter your Advocate Code or Party-in-Person Code and press GET OTP to get OTP on your registered mobile number.
ONLINE METHOD TO BOOK SLOT FOR PHYSICAL FILING AT COURT COUNTER
� On next screen
On requesting OTP you will be prompted with OTP, BOOKING DATE & availability of slots for next two court working days as
below.
ONLINE METHOD TO BOOK SLOT FOR PHYSICAL FILING AT COURT COUNTER
� Please input as below
i. First enter the OTP received.
ii. Select BOOKING DATE (on which you are willing to file the case physically at court counter).
iii. Select the side i.e. Civil or Criminal
iv. Based on your side selection, It will show all slots & availability in each slot for booking of Physical Filing.
Book your desired slot by pressing BOOK SLOT button next to that slot.
ONLINE METHOD TO BOOK SLOT FOR PHYSICAL FILING AT COURT COUNTER
� On Successful validation of OTP, You will receive slot booking confirmation SMS as well as alert shown below.
